Persona

Tom Adeyemi

Author; writes reports and decks as HTML, often with a coding agent, and asks people to review them

Goal
Collect every reviewer's comments pinned to the exact place, and hand them to an agent that acts on them.
In their words
“Paste the comments in, and the agent knows where each one goes. (invented)”

Journeys

2
  • Add Pipeup to a pageDesignedTom adds one script tag and a document key to his page, runs the check that says what Pipeup changes or covers, and sends the page.
  • Collect feedback from several reviewersDesignedTom opens his page with three reviewers' threads on it, copies every comment as Markdown that says who wrote what and where, and hands it to his coding agent.

About Tom

What matters to them

  • Adding review to a page with one line, and keeping every other byte of the page as it was.
  • Comments that say where they are, so an agent or a colleague can act on them.
  • Reviewers who never need an account or a server he has to run.
  • Comments that follow the content when the page changes.

Frustrations

  • Feedback arriving in five chat threads with no place attached.
  • Review tools that restyle or wrap the page.
More about them

Context

  • Writes specs, reports and slide decks as standalone HTML, much of it generated by a coding agent.
  • Sends the file or a link to a few reviewers, then pastes what comes back into the agent.
  • A typical page has three to five reviewers, often reviewing at the same time, so comments from several people arrive together and each copy must say who wrote what.

Access needs

  • The same as reviewers: low vision (larger text, the contrast theme) and motor needs (keyboard-only and switch use); an author reviews their own page too.

Scenarios

  1. I made an HTML deck and want feedback. I add Pipeup to it and send the file.
  2. Several people reviewed my file separately. Each sends me their copied comments; I paste them into my agent.
  3. My page changed since people commented. The comments follow the content, and the ones that can't are flagged.

Not for

  • Running a review service: Pipeup never needs a server of his.
